title: A tense negotiation
watchFor: Oria negotiates from her own agenda (pay down her debt, keep the client secret) and never hurries; she should give ground slowly and extract something in return. A Persuasion or Intimidation check should decide how far she moves. Vex should back the player in fragments, not take over. Nobody agrees to anything on the player's behalf.
turns: Triple the fee, or find someone else to swim into a flooded pump station.
Then tell me who wants the case so badly. That's worth something to me.
Half up front, in cinders, tonight. Or Vex and I walk out that door.
